intent: Specify the public slice-descriptor API of `static_filez::slice`: `pack_in_u64` and `unpack_from_u64`.

manual_mutants.note: checked multiplication instead of shift: panics for offsets >= 2^32 instead of truncating
length masked to 31 bits: lengths >= 2^31 corrupted

sibling_mutants.note: length masked to its low 32 bits before packing (offset no longer corrupted by lengths >= 2^32)

bug_variants.note: operator precedence: `input & 0xFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000 >> 32` parses as `input & (0xFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000 >> 32)`, so the offset returned by unpack_from_u64 is the low 32 bits (= the length) instead of the high 32 bits: unpack no longer inverts pack_in_u64 (round trip broken for every offset != length)
